reason: E1 shows that an inverted BCC+B2 microstructure improves ductility in RHEAs, but it does not mention Ti or NbMoTaW; E2 only provides general background on NbMoTaW brittleness. No cited evidence supports the specific claims that Ti induces this microstructure in NbMoTaW, enhances grain boundary cohesion, or maintains high-temperature strength and irradiation resistance.
